name: ICT method comparison 3010 final
purpose: Compare reflection-question outputs of Fixed Question Bank, RAG and constrained LLM using the same frozen ICT cases and method-blind scripts.

metric_rules.usefulness: One nonrepeated question, <=40 words; reflection/learning/approach/planning cue; no listed coercive wording. These are form and wording rules, not measured educational benefit.
metric_rules.context_fit: ICT scenario, no unsupported named technology, shared content words with scenario evidence. No lexical anchor is inconclusive. Bank applicability conditions, method and model never affect the score.
metric_rules.correctness: Check recognized completion/incorrect-answer claims and named technologies against scenario evidence. Unsupported claims are flags. No recognized, testable claim is inconclusive; lack of a flag does not establish truth.

review_policy: Brief assistant-assisted content/structure review before freezing; not independent human validation. Repairs retain version history and are documented. No test-output-driven bank, prompt or metric changes.
comparison_policy: Same scenario versions, one repetition, same generator and settings for RAG/LLM. Report failed outputs and inconclusive metrics. No statistical sufficiency or semantic-validation claim.
